paper_title: Novel bounds on decaying axionlike particle dark matter from the cosmic background
suggested_experiment_name: Cosmic Background (COB/CUB/CXB) decaying ALP DM constraint
coupling_convention: canonical g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Constraints on axion/ALP-photon coupling g_agamma from decaying DM contribution to the cosmic background (optical-to-X-ray), masses 0.5 eV - 1e7 eV, at 2sigma confidence (CUBA-model based overall/white-line constraint). Coupling type unambiguously AxionPhoton. Data points are APPROXIMATE reconstructions: the paper reports constraints only graphically (Fig. 3); I anchored the normalization to their statements ('improve previous EBL/Cadamuro-Redondo bound by ~1 order of magnitude', 'reaching the QCD band', 'rule out DFSZ/KSVZ between 2-30 eV') and applied the fitted power-law slopes g_agamma ∝ m_a^(-0.245) reported in Appendix C. Actual per-region features/sharp dips (Dark Cloud, AKARI, CXB bins) are not captured. DM density ρ_a=ρ_DM=0.42 GeV/cm^3 (local NFW) assumed; cosmic component assumes Ωa=ΩDM. Treat numeric values as order-of-magnitude/trend estimates. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.5, 36)) | Vision: Fig. 3 axion-photon plane (x = m_a c^2 [eV], log; y = g_agamma [GeV^-1], log). Note the x-axis is ascending (mass increases to the right) even though the wavelength correlation is descending. The paper's novel exclusion is the shaded blue (COB, ~0.15-3 eV), orange (CUB, ~3-1000 eV) and pink (CXB, ~100-1e7 eV) regions, bounded below by the black 'overall constraint' line that includes local DM halo decay. Excluded region is ABOVE the boundary. The plot is very busy with overlapping gray previous-constraint regions, LORRI-excess bands, KSVZ/DFSZ diagonal lines, and an inset zoom of the COB regime, so point readings are approximate (2-sigma / Delta-chi^2=5.99 confidence).
